title: Aurora UI
description: Gradientes fluxo animado, efeito Northern Lights, cores complementares. Interface luminosa e atmosférica. Prompt para gradientes dinâmicos.
use_case: SaaS premium, Creative tools, Agência moderna, Brand exclusiva
historical_context: Mesh gradients (2021+) e CSS Houdini trazem animações fluidas tipo Northern Lights. Popular em SaaS premium e creative tools.
cores_primarias: Complementary: Blue-Orange, Purple-Yellow, Electric Blue #0080FF, Magenta #FF1493, Cyan #00FFFF
cores_secundarias: Smooth transitions (Blue→Purple→Pink→Teal), iridescent effects, blend modes (screen, multiply)
efeitos: Large flowing CSS/SVG gradients, subtle 8-12s animations, depth via color layering, smooth morph
